summary: Contract suite established: curated emoji-runtime fixtures, automated runner, and pytest coverage keep Toyfoundry/Toysoldiers promotion flow in lockstep.

notes: Mapped Level-0 templates and translator intent fields against factory adapter directives to ensure test coverage spans action, qualifier, and multi-outcome paths.

Added tests/test_contract_test_runner.py to invoke the suite via pytest and documented the workflow in README utilities section.
This report archived after runner execution; evidence attached for fixtures and test output snippets.
